results.text: Safety, Growth, and Development After Dapagliflozin or Saxagliptin in Children With Type 2 Diabetes (T2NOW Follow-Up). The T2NOW trial of dapagliflozin or saxagliptin vs placebo in pediatric patients with type 2 diabetes (T2D) demonstrated promising efficacy data for dapagliflozin and did not raise any safety concerns over 52 weeks.
